definition: קִלְּשׁוֺן doubtful word, in phrase ׳ וְלִשְׁלשׁ ק 1Sam 13:21 (possibly would be fine point , compare Aramaic קלשׁ be thin , hence ׳ ק ׳ שׁ tridens , E.V. forks , but against analogue, see especially Dr ). קָמָה see קום .

קִלְּשׁוֺן doubtful word, in phrase ׳וְלִשְׁלשׁ ק 1Sam 13:21 (possibly would be fine point, compare Aramaic קלשׁ be thin, hence ׳ק ׳שׁ tridens, E.V. forks, but against analogue, see especially Dr).

קָמָה see קום.
